symptom: `revoke` of a right that is already gone prints "No access rules found matching M.Role on M.Entity" — reads like an error on an idempotent re-run (exit 0)
cause: the no-op branches of `execRevokeEntityAccess` (partial and full) worded the outcome as a failed lookup instead of the Unchanged form other idempotent writes use
insight: Wording only; an idempotent no-op should say Unchanged so it is not mistaken for a failure in script logs
